input.overview: Secret Agent Showdown is a standalone lock-and-Multiball game on the Lexy Lightspeed module. The qualification phase serves eight balls; shoot as many of them as possible into the spaceship's physical lock. The ship then releases the successful locks, and the ramps score Jackpots while two or more balls remain.
input.simpleOverview: During the eight-ball qualification phase, shoot every served ball into the spaceship lock. The ship then releases the locked balls for Multiball; shoot the ramps for Jackpots until only one ball remains.
input.summary: Use each of the eight served balls to fill the spaceship lock. After qualification, the ship releases the balls you successfully locked; shoot the ramps for Jackpots during the resulting Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Eight-ball qualification
quickInfo.summary: The game supplies eight lock opportunities. A missed or drained attempt means one fewer ball in the coming Multiball.

quickInfo.name: Spaceship lock
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the physical spaceship to store each served ball during qualification; it can hold as many as eight.

quickInfo.name: Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: After the ship releases the locked balls, shoot the ramps for Jackpots while Multiball remains active.

quickInfo.name: Super Duper Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: The current game advertises a larger final Jackpot, but its exact qualification is unclear; follow the display instead of assuming a shot sequence.

steps.text: For each served qualification ball, control it and shoot the spaceship opening to add that ball to the physical lock.
Repeat through all eight opportunities. Every successful lock adds another ball to the Multiball that follows.
When the qualification phase ends, prepare at the flippers as the spaceship releases all successfully locked balls.
During Multiball, shoot the left and right ramps for Jackpots and keep the loose balls under control.
Continue collecting ramp Jackpots until only one ball remains and the standalone game ends.
Treat every qualification drain as a lost Multiball ball, so take time to control before shooting the lock.
After release, trap one ball when possible and use the other to repeat a ramp Jackpot.
Follow the display if the Super Duper Jackpot lights; its qualification is intentionally not inferred here.

playfieldReferences.label: Eight-ball spaceship lock
playfieldReferences.description: The upper physical spaceship opening that stores qualification balls and releases them for Multiball.

playfieldReferences.label: Jackpot ramps
playfieldReferences.description: The two ramp shots that score Jackpots during the released-ball phase.

cautions.issue: Secret Agent Showdown is separate from Lexy Lightspeed – Escape From Earth.
cautions.response: Select the standalone Secret Agent Showdown app; do not apply its eight-ball structure to the full game.

cautions.issue: The Super Duper Jackpot's exact qualification is unclear and may vary by software.
cautions.response: Collect the ramp Jackpots and follow the display if the larger award lights instead of assuming a count or shot.
